'''Business and economy'''
*The first [[Legoland]] in China opens in [[Shanghai]]. [https://apnews.com/article/shanghai-legoland-resort-opening-china-2fdc5631835c233af9fe4207874c361d (AP News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*In [[Glendora, Mississippi]], 13 cars of a Canadian National freight train derail, including one car spilling benzene, forcing an evacuation of the area. [https://www.pressregister.com/firefighters-battling-train-tanker-fire-near-glendora-where-village-has-been-evacuated-6869e3e80ee09 (''Press-Register'')]
*
*Two minibuses collide head-on in [[Egypt]], killing nine and injuring 11. [https://www.newarab.com/news/egypt-minibus-crash-kills-9-says-health-ministry (The New Arab)]
*A minivan collided with a locomotive in [[Mpika]], [[Zambia]] killing nine. [https://www.zambiamonitor.com/nine-dead-in-mpika-crash-involving-toyota-mini-van-tazara-train/ (Zambia Monitor)]
*A light propeller aircraft originating from Germany, crashes near [[Wald im Pinzgau]], [[Austria]], killing all four people on board. [https://apnews.com/article/austria-plane-crash-09d78c0c52afdf12a11f49062167378a (AP News)]
*Four people are killed after an abandoned open cast coal mine collapsed in [[Ramgarh district]], [[India]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ranchi/jharkhand-illegal-mine-collapse-5-dead-several-feared-trapped-in-ramgarhs-karma-project-area/articleshow/122261104.cms (The Times Of India)]
*A boat, capable of carrying forty passengers, sank in conditions of strong winds in [[Dongjiang Lake]], [[China]]. Of the 29 people on board, 27 were rescued and two died. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/2-killed-27-rescued-after-boat-sank-in-central-china/3623344 (AA)]
